verses.text: David sang this song to the LORD when the LORD rescued him from Saul and from all his other enemies.
He said, “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and the one who rescues me.
My God is the rock I run to for shelter. He's my shield, the mighty strength that saves me, my strong tower, and my refuge. You're my savior. You save me from violence.
I call out to the LORD, who deserves praise, and he saves me from my enemies.
Waves of death closed in around me. Floods of wickedness terrified me.
The ropes of the grave wrapped around me, and death's traps caught me.
In my trouble I called out to the LORD. I cried to my God. From his temple he heard my voice. My cry reached his ears.
Then the earth shook and trembled. The very foundations of heaven quaked and shook because he was angry.
Smoke rose from his nostrils. Fire poured from his mouth and set coals ablaze.
He bent the skies and came down with thick darkness under his feet.
He rode on a cherub and flew, appearing on the wings of the wind.
He wrapped himself in darkness like a shelter, with waters gathered in the thick clouds of the sky.
In the brightness ahead of him, coals burst into flame.
The LORD thundered from heaven. The Most High raised his voice.
He shot his arrows and scattered his enemies. His lightning threw them into confusion.
The channels of the sea came into view, and the world's foundations lay bare at the LORD's rebuke, at the blast of breath from his nostrils.
He reached down from high above and took hold of me. He pulled me out of deep waters.
He rescued me from my powerful enemy and from those who hated me, because they were too strong for me.
They came after me on the day disaster struck, but the LORD held me up.
He brought me out into a wide, open place. He rescued me because he delighted in me.
The LORD rewarded me for doing what was right. He repaid me because my hands were clean.
I've stayed on the LORD's paths and haven't turned away from my God to do wrong.
I've kept all his rulings in front of me and haven't strayed from what he commanded.
I've lived with integrity before him and kept myself from wrongdoing.
So the LORD rewarded me for doing what was right and for being clean in his sight.
To the merciful you show mercy, and to people of integrity you show your integrity.
To the pure you show yourself pure, and to the crooked you show yourself shrewd.
You save people who are suffering, and you keep your eyes on the arrogant to bring them down.
You are my lamp, LORD. The LORD lights up my darkness.
With your help I can charge a troop. With my God I can leap over a wall.
God's way is flawless. The LORD's word has stood the test. He's a shield to everyone who takes refuge in him.
Who is God besides the LORD? Who is a rock besides our God?
God is my strong fortress. He makes my path secure.
He gives me feet like a deer's and sets me high above the ground.
He trains my hands for battle so my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
You've given me your shield to save me. Your gentleness has made me great.
You've widened the path under my feet, and my footing hasn't slipped.
I chased my enemies and destroyed them. I didn't turn back until they were wiped out.
I struck them down until they couldn't get up. They fell beneath my feet.
You gave me strength for battle. You brought those who rose against me down beneath me.
You made my enemies turn and run, and I cut down those who hated me.
They looked for help, but nobody came to save them. They looked to the LORD, but he gave them no answer.
I ground them as fine as dust. I crushed them like mud in the streets and scattered them.
You rescued me from the conflicts of my own people. You kept me as ruler over nations. People I didn't know will serve me.
People from foreign lands will submit to me. As soon as they hear of me, they'll obey.
Their courage will fade, and they'll come out of hiding trembling.
The LORD lives! Praise my rock! Lift up God, the rock who saves me.
He is the God who brings me justice and puts peoples under my rule.
He takes me away from my enemies. You lift me above those who rise against me and rescue me from violent men.
So I'll thank you among the nations, LORD, and sing praises to your name.
He gives great victories to his king and shows faithful love to his anointed one, to David and his descendants forever.”
